name: tests
on:
  push:
  pull_request:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.10", "3.12"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - run: python -m pip install pytest
      - name: freight_packets
        working-directory: freight_packets
        run: python -m pytest -q
      - name: pt_auth
        working-directory: pt_auth
        run: python -m pytest -q
      - name: utility_watch
        working-directory: utility_watch
        run: python -m pytest -q

name: Freight what-if

"on":
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - ".github/workflows/freight-whatif.yml"
      - "demos/freight-whatif/**"
      - "freight_packets/freightpkt/**"
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - ".github/workflows/freight-whatif.yml"
      - "demos/freight-whatif/**"
      - "freight_packets/freightpkt/**"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: freight-whatif-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    env:
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
      PYTHONUNBUFFERED: "1"
      TZ: UTC
    steps:
      - name: Check out source
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # official v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Python 3.12
        uses: actions/setup-python@ece7cb06caefa5fff74198d8649806c4678c61a1 # official v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Set up Node 24 LTS
        uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # official v6
        with:
          node-version: "24"
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Verify pinned rules and generated fixtures
        run: python demos/freight-whatif/tools/build_fixtures.py --check
      - name: Check model parity and input boundaries
        run: node demos/freight-whatif/tests/model.test.mjs
      - name: Exercise isolated installation and rollback
        run: |
          freight_receiving_root="$(mktemp -d "${RUNNER_TEMP:?}/freight-whatif.XXXXXXXX")"
          trap 'rm -rf -- "$freight_receiving_root"' EXIT
          python demos/freight-whatif/tests/install.test.py \
            --work-root "$freight_receiving_root/receiving" \
            --output "$freight_receiving_root/install-receipt.json"

# workflow-checks

Three small programs that do the checking a back-office person does by hand, and show their evidence for every call.

**Live sample outputs: https://jacobmetoyer.com/workflow-checks/** (generated by running the code below on its sample data)

> **Synthetic data, not deployed for any client.** Every company, person, patient, account and amount in this repository is invented by a seeded generator. These are demos of an approach, not products, and no savings or accuracy figures are claimed for real data.

## What each check catches

| Demo | Who it is for | It catches | You get |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Freight packets](freight_packets/README.md) | Carrier and broker billing / settlement staff | Billable detention from geofence or tracking times (free time, grace, increments, caps); late arrivals; carrier invoice lines that don't match the rate con (linehaul, fuel, accessorials, totals); duplicate invoices; missing POD; carrier fines backed by evidence, with a 7-day dispute window | One draft packet per load with the calculation and evidence timeline, `invoice_flags.csv`, `settlement.csv` (READY / HOLD and net payable), an exception queue |
| [PT authorizations](pt_auth/README.md) | Authorization specialists at multi-clinic outpatient PT groups | Scheduled visits outside any approved auth; completed visits with no auth; re-auths due by visits-left or days-left per payer rule; pending auths with visits coming up; annual visit caps; unknown payers | A prioritized daily worklist (P1/P2/P3) with submit-by dates and the payer's checklist, a printable digest, an auth ledger |
| [Utility bills](utility_watch/README.md) | AP staff paying utility bills across a multifamily portfolio | Usage spikes against the same month last year (so seasonal swings aren't flagged), rate jumps, duplicate bills, overlapping periods, missing bills, late fees, payment mismatches, unpaid past-due bills, usage at vacant units | `flags.csv`, an exception queue, a payment-approval queue (nothing is paid), a one-file HTML report |

Every decision is written to an append-only `audit.jsonl` with a `file:row` pointer to the input that caused it. Anything the rules can't judge goes to a person, not a guess.

## Sample input → output

Utility bills. Two input rows from `utility_watch/sample_data/bills.csv` (synthetic), the same gas account a year apart:

```
bill_id,account_no,vendor_invoice_no,period_start,period_end,usage,usage_unit,amount,late_fee,prior_balance,due_date,received_date
B50020,SYN-7002,GULF-50020,2025-04-01,2025-04-30,1480.65,therm,1640.56,0.0,0.0,2025-06-05,2025-05-03
B50032,SYN-7002,GULF-50032,2026-04-01,2026-04-30,2780.11,therm,3058.42,0.0,0.0,2026-06-06,2026-05-04
```

Output rows from `flags.csv`:

```
B50032  Cypress Court (synthetic)  gas    USAGE_SPIKE           92.7 therm/day vs 49.4 same month last year (x1.88)   bills.csv:33 bills.csv:21
B50125  Bayou Flats (synthetic)    water  PAYMENT_MISMATCH      owed $4,232.12; 2 payment(s) totalling $8,464.24       bills.csv:126 payments.csv:120 payments.csv:121
B50087  Bayou Flats (synthetic)    elec.  LATE_FEE_OR_PAST_DUE  late fee $179.02, prior balance $3,222.36 on the bill  bills.csv:88
```

Freight. Output row from `invoice_flags.csv`:

```
CAL-7101  LD260907  LINEHAUL_MISMATCH  linehaul: invoiced $1,532.00 vs rate-con $1,382.00  variance $150.00  carrier_invoices.csv:row6; RC-48001.txt
```

PT. Output row from `worklist.csv`:

```
P1  SYN-1014  Medicare Advantage Plan (placeholder)  AUTH-70039  UNCOVERED_VISIT|REAUTH_BY_VISITS  1 of 7 visits left (payer threshold 4); 8 scheduled visits outside any approved auth
```

The full outputs, including the HTML packets and reports, are on the [sample outputs site](https://jacobmetoyer.com/workflow-checks/).

## Run it in 60 seconds

Needs Python 3.10+. The demos use only the standard library; `pytest` is for the tests.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Jacob-Met/workflow-checks && cd workflow-checks
cd utility_watch && python -m uwatch run --data sample_data --out out --as-of 2026-09-28 && cd ..
# open utility_watch/out/report.html
cd freight_packets && python -m freightpkt run --data sample_data --out out && cd ..
# open freight_packets/out/packets/*.html, or browse it: python -m freightpkt serve --data sample_data --out out  (http://127.0.0.1:8765)
cd pt_auth && python -m ptauth run --data sample_data --out out --as-of 2026-09-28 && cd ..
# open pt_auth/out/digest.html, or: python -m ptauth serve --data sample_data --out out  (http://127.0.0.1:8766)
```

Tests (130 in total):

```sh
pip install pytest
(cd freight_packets && python -m pytest -q)
(cd pt_auth && python -m pytest -q)
(cd utility_watch && python -m pytest -q)
```

On Windows PowerShell, `.\demo.ps1 freight|pt|utility|test` does the same. `python scripts/build_pages.py` runs the tests and rebuilds the sample outputs site in `docs/`.

## How it is built

- **Synthetic data only.** Seeded generators write an independent answer key (`expected.json`) that the tests check against.
- **Deterministic rules first.** Anything uncertain goes to a human exception queue, and nothing is sent, filed, paid or submitted.
- **No paid APIs, no network calls, no model calls.** The local UIs are single pages with no CDN and bind to 127.0.0.1.

## What the tests do and do not show

- **They show internal consistency.** Each generator writes the synthetic data and an `expected.json` answer key from the same seed, and the tests check the engine against that key plus hand-written edge cases (see each `HARDENING.md`). A green run means the rules do what the README says on data built to exercise them.
- **They do not show real-world accuracy, savings or time saved.** No result here was measured on a real company's exports, so none is claimed. Any figure in a demo script (for example a detention total) is a property of the synthetic sample, not a typical or expected result.
- **A real pilot starts from a baseline.** The per-PoC READMEs list what a pilot needs: the client's own exports, their real rules, and a manual audit to compare against. Claims about a pilot would be limited to what that comparison measured, for that client and period.

## Status, support and contributions

- **Demos, provided as-is.** No warranty, no support commitment and no maintenance schedule. They are not production software and must not be pointed at real patient, financial or personal data as they stand (see `pt_auth/README.md` for the HIPAA gaps).
- **Not accepting outside contributions** for now. Issues may be read but are not guaranteed a reply.
- **Licensed under the MIT License** (see [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)). The runtime has no third-party dependencies; `pytest` (MIT) is a test-only dependency and is not distributed here.

## Contact

Interested in a scoped pilot on your own redacted exports? See [jacobmetoyer.com](https://jacobmetoyer.com).

"""Rebuild the static sample-output site in docs/ by running each demo on its bundled synthetic data. Usage (from the repo root): python scripts/build_pages.py Runs the three test suites first and stops if any fail. Standard library + pytest only. """ from __future__ import annotations import csv, html, json, shutil, subprocess, sys from pathlib import Path ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent DOCS = ROOT / "docs" AS_OF = "2026-09-28" # fixed review date so the published outputs are reproducible DEMOS = [ ("freight_packets", ["-m", "freightpkt", "run", "--data", "sample_data", "--out", "../docs/freight"]), ("pt_auth", ["-m", "ptauth", "run", "--data", "sample_data", "--out", "../docs/pt", "--as-of", AS_OF]), ("utility_watch", ["-m", "uwatch", "run", "--data", "sample_data", "--out", "../docs/utility", "--as-of", AS_OF]), ] def run(args, cwd): print("+", " ".join(args), f"(in {cwd.name})", flush=True) subprocess.run([sys.executable, *args], cwd=cwd, check=True) def main() -> None: for folder, _ in DEMOS: run(["-m", "pytest", "-q"], ROOT / folder) for sub in ("freight", "pt", "utility"): shutil.rmtree(DOCS / sub, ignore_errors=True) DOCS.mkdir(exist_ok=True) for folder, args in DEMOS: run(args, ROOT / folder) (DOCS / ".nojekyll").write_text("") f = json.loads((DOCS / "freight" / "summary.json").read_text())["counts"] p = json.loads((DOCS / "pt" / "summary.json").read_text())["counts"] u = json.loads((DOCS / "utility" / "summary.json").read_text()) write_index(f, p, u) print("freight", f, "\npt", p, "\nutility flags", u["flags"], "exceptions", u["exceptions"]) REPO = "https://github.com/Jacob-Met/workflow-checks" def table(path: Path, cols: list[str], limit: int = 6) -> str: with path.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as fh: rows = list(csv.DictReader(fh)) head = "".join(f"{html.escape(c)}" for c in cols) body = "".join("" + "".join(f"{html.escape(r.get(c, ''))}" for c in cols) + "" for r in rows[:limit]) more = f"

Showing {min(limit, len(rows))} of {len(rows)} rows. Full CSV

" return f"{head}{body}
{more}" def write_index(f: dict, p: dict, u: dict) -> None: packets = sorted((DOCS / "freight" / "packets").glob("*.html")) plinks = " ".join(f"{x.stem}" for x in packets) out = f""" workflow-checks: sample outputs (synthetic data)

workflow-checks: sample outputs

Synthetic data, not deployed in any real operation. Every company, person, patient, account and amount here was invented by a seeded generator. Nothing was sent, paid or filed.

These pages are the actual output of running the three demos in the repository on their bundled sample data (review date {AS_OF}), after their test suites passed. Rebuild them yourself with python scripts/build_pages.py.

  • Freight: detention packets and carrier invoice audit
  • Physical therapy: authorization worklist
  • Utilities: bill exceptions and payment queue

Freight: detention packets and carrier invoice audit

Input: a TMS load list, telematics or tracking stop events, rate confirmations and carrier invoices for {f['loads']} loads. Output: {f['packets']} draft detention/late-arrival packets, {f['invoice_flags']} invoice flags, {f['fines']} evidence-backed fines, {f['exceptions']} exceptions held for a person, and a settlement worksheet ({f['settlement_ready']} READY, {f['settlement_hold']} HOLD).

Draft packets (one per load; calculation, evidence timeline, approval block): {plinks}

Invoice flags

{table(DOCS/'freight'/'invoice_flags.csv', ['invoice_no','load_id','flag','detail','variance','evidence'])}

Settlement worksheet

{table(DOCS/'freight'/'settlement.csv', ['invoice_no','load_id','invoiced','approved','fines','net_payable','status','hold_reasons'])}

Exceptions (never claimed, sent to a person)

{table(DOCS/'freight'/'exceptions.csv', ['load_id','stop','reason','evidence'])}

Physical therapy: authorization worklist

Input: a visit schedule, authorizations, a per-payer rules table and patients ({p['patients']} synthetic patients, {p['visits']} visits, {p['auths']} auths). Output: a prioritized daily worklist of {p['worklist']} items ({p['p1']} P1, {p['p2']} P2), each with a reason code, a submit-by date and the payer checklist. Open the printable daily digest.

{table(DOCS/'pt'/'worklist.csv', ['priority','patient_id','payer','auth_no','reasons','visits_remaining','submit_by','detail'])}

Utilities: bill exceptions and payment queue

Input: utility accounts, {u['bills']} bills, payments and unit occupancy for {u['accounts']} accounts. Output: {u['flags']} flags (spikes against the same month last year, rate changes, duplicates, overlaps, missing bills, late fees, payment mismatches, vacant-unit usage), {u['exceptions']} exceptions, and {u['payment_queue']} clean bills queued for approval (not paid). Open the full report.

{table(DOCS/'utility'/'flags.csv', ['property','utility','account_no','code','detail','evidence'], 12)}

Want this on your own exports?

A scoped pilot runs on your own redacted exports and is compared against a manual audit. See jacobmetoyer.com. Code: {REPO} (MIT).

""" (DOCS / "index.html").write_text(out, encoding="utf-8") if __name__ == "__main__": main()
